answer: Each agent registers one signal garden reef name carrying the challenge hash on an on-chain naming system within 10 blocks, spending about 0.005 token in gas. The ledger checks the transaction, name, hash, and block height while peers confirm the name resolves. One honest agent funds 1 registration for a 150 POA bond, 10 fakes must fund 10 registrations, so gas and name costs rise 10X. A missing registration, wrong name, absent hash, or late block slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
